project.title: Tock App
project.goal: Create a world-class native app that keeps guests coming back again and again, driving butts in seats for our customers.
project.value: Guests are dining out more than ever, but the abundance of choice can be overwhelming. The Tock consumer app makes it easy to discover and book unforgettable experiences, while helping restaurants, wineries, and hospitality businesses drive demand, fill seats, and grow.
project.role: I was part of a trio stood up specifically to rebuild the Tock consumer app as fully native, replacing a React Native web wrapper. I owned all things design, and acted as product owner and set direction.

images.alt: A restaurant on the map, its profile and experiences, and its awards

next.title: Global Pathogen Analysis System
next.goal: Give researchers and public health authorities around the world one standardized cloud platform for analyzing and comparing COVID-19 genomic data, so they can spot emerging variants sooner.
next.value: Researchers lacked the infrastructure to process sequences quickly and share results securely across borders. Built with the University of Oxford, the platform gave them one standardized place to analyze their data, and labs could choose to share results with others.
next.role: I was a Sr. UX Designer on Oracle's design team, working with Oxford University's product manager, research scientists, and public health officials. I improved the design to make the data easier to understand through clearer organization and visualizations.

impact.label: Time for labs to receive processed sequences
